title: French Trout Pilaf
description: A delicate French-inspired pilaf dish featuring pan-seared trout and perfectly cooked rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the polish sausage and cook until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add the pilaf rice and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
While the rice cooks, season the trout fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil and sear the trout fillets for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the trout fillets on top of the pilaf rice, garnished with a lemon wedge.
